1.consolidated_definition: Planta ornamental y medicinal oriunda de la China. Su tallo y su hoja, color castaño, se parece a la del bambú aunque más ancha. Echa flores de color violeta oscuro, con cinco pétalos.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Ornamental and medicinal plant native to China. Its stem and leaf, with a brown color, resemble those of bamboo but are wider. It produces dark violet flowers with five petals.
